Subject: PO fields / net terms / invoice cadence question

Rachel —

Thanks for the demo last week — product looked great. Procurement asked me to confirm a few mandatory PO/invoice fields before we move to the contracting stage. Our standard template (attached) requires: PO Number, Billing Entity (legal name + remit-to address), BU Code, Nebula Tax ID, Contract Reference Number, and a specific GL code per invoice line.

A couple of constraints from finance that will drive our side: we prefer Net60 but can accept Net45 with a commercial concession; we also need invoices to be aggregated monthly (single monthly consolidated invoice for all usage) rather than weekly.

Can Redwood accept the PO field set above as-is? Also, do you offer any packaging/discount for committing to a 12-month minimum consumption? If so, what changes to invoice cadence or PO formatting would you need for that discount to be eligible?

I attached our PO template for reference (Nebula_PO_template.xlsx).

Appreciate a clear list of required fields and any examples of the invoice format so I can circulate with AP.

—Justin

Hi Justin —

Thanks for the template and clear list. Quick answers up front:
- Required PO fields: we can accept PO Number, Billing Entity, Tax ID, Contract Reference Number, BU Code and a GL line. Redwood requires the billing entity to be exactly "Redwood Inference, Inc." and the remit-to address must match our AR record (I included the exact remit-to in the footer).
- Net terms: our standard is Net30. For Net45 we can accept a 5% one-time discount applied to the first invoice as a concession for extending terms to Net45. Net60 is outside standard practice for hosted customers without a prepay or committed spend.
- Invoice cadence: we support consolidated monthly invoices (one invoice per month) — that aligns well with your request and is compatible with our billing system.

If you are exploring a 12-month commitment, we typically offer a tiered discount (5% for 12-month commit with monthly aggregated billing; 7% for 12-month commit + prepay option). The discount levels depend on whether you want monthly invoices or a prepaid ladder. For a 7% discount we would need either a prepayment schedule or an automated charge-back PO that references the contract and allows Redwood to invoice monthly against that PO with a single contract reference number.

I've attached a short pricing summary that shows the two options. If it helps, Ben (copied) can provide the commercial exception language. Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow to align with procurement and AP.

Best,

Subject: Re: PO fields / net terms / invoice cadence question — commercial proposal

Justin / Rachel —

Following Rachel's note: quick commercial proposal from my side to make this operationally clean for both teams. Two viable paths: 

Option A — Flexible monthly billing (no prepay):
  - 12-month committed spend (minimum $150k ARR equivalent)
  - Monthly consolidated invoice per what Justin requested (single invoice covering the month)
  - Net45 payment terms
  - 5% recurring discount applied to invoices while commitment is active
  - PO must contain "Contract Ref: NB-4521" and list Redwood Inference, Inc. as billing entity + remit-to address (required for our AR system)

Option B — Prepay ladder (preferred for deeper discount):
  - 12-month commit with quarterly prepay (4 equal prepayments)
  - Monthly usage reconciled against prepaid balance, single monthly statement for detail
  - Net30 on final reconciled charges or Net30 on quarterly replenishment invoices
  - 7% discount on committed base consumption (overage billed at standard list rate)
  - Requires a signed SOW and DocuSign envelope; PO may reference the DocuSign envelope ID instead of line-level GL codes

Operational asks to make Option A work: PO must include Billing Entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Remit-to, Contract Ref NB-4521, and an AP contact email. We can accept your GL code per line as part of the invoice detail (we will include GL in the line-level description field), but our AR system needs the contract ref and remit-to to match exactly.

If Nebula is comfortable with Option A, we can approve Net45 + 5% and I will issue a commercial amendment to the MSA and provide the DocuSign link. If you prefer Option B, sign the DocuSign and we will apply the 7% committed discount.

Rachel — can you please confirm the exact remit-to address we should expect on the PO? Justin — if you can confirm whether AP can sign for Net45 vs Net60, we can lock terms.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
